title: Transition Accommodations
description: Accommodations that help a student move between activities, classrooms, or routines. Use when the student struggles with change, needs advance notice, or requires visual/temporal scaffolding to switch tasks or settings.

source.name: ADayInOurShoes — Ultimate List of IEP Accommodations, Modifications & Strategies (SDIs)

accommodations.text: Visual cues in hallways to guide the child to the next classroom or cafeteria.
Personal time-outs to regroup and prepare for transition.
Time warnings and increased transition time.
Schedule posted on the blackboard, whiteboard, or smartboard.
